description: Cue helps people improve AI prompts before they send them and can show the connected Cue account and plan in ChatGPT Work mode. A product of cue-prompt.com, independently developed and not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

defaultPrompt: Review my AI prompt and improve it without changing my intent.
Score this prompt from 0–10 and tell me what is missing.
In Work mode, what Cue account and plan am I connected with?
interface.longDescription: Cue scores AI prompts, explains what is missing and rewrites prompts while preserving their original intent. Connect your Cue account in ChatGPT Work mode to use prompt improvement and check the connected account. Cue is a product of cue-prompt.com and is independently developed, not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

positive.description: Core improvement. Setup: ChatGPT Work mode, Cue connected by OAuth using dedicated reviewer account, sufficient prompt quota. Status: Reviewer MCP tool check passed on 12 October 2026 through the separate cue-reviewer OAuth connection in Codex CLI. ChatGPT Work conversational flow remains unvalidated.
positive.prompt: Improve this AI prompt: make me a calendar
positive.expected_behavior: prompt = "make me a calendar". Return score (number 0–10), feedback, label and one rewrite grounded in the response. Rewrite asks for missing purpose/date range/commitments rather than inventing them.

positive.description: Preserve supplied constraints. Setup: ChatGPT Work mode, Cue connected by OAuth using dedicated reviewer account, sufficient prompt quota. positive.prompt: Review this AI prompt: Write a friendly reminder email to my team about submitting timesheets by Friday. Keep it under 100 words.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the supplied prompt to improve_prompt. Show the returned score, feedback and rewrite; preserve friendly tone, team audience, Friday deadline and under-100-word constraint. Do not invent company details.

positive.prompt: Mejora este prompt para IA: Sugiere una cena vegetariana para cuatro personas con un presupuesto de 30 euros.
positive.expected_behavior: Pass the Spanish prompt to improve_prompt. Feedback and rewrite remain in Spanish; preserve vegetarian meal, four people and 30-euro budget. Show the tool-returned score, not a predetermined value.

review.commerce_description: Cue offers an optional paid plan, Cue Premium, providing expanded/higher usage of its prompt-improvement features. The ChatGPT plugin scores and improves AI prompts, returns feedback and a rewritten prompt, connects to a Cue account, checks the connected account/plan, and applies Free versus paid Cue usage entitlement. Users upgrade within Cue at https://cue-prompt.com; web purchases are processed through Stripe. Current options are GBP 4.99/month, GBP 39.99/year, or GBP 9.99 lifetime. The MCP tools improve_prompt and get_profile do not process payments or change subscriptions.

publication.release_notes: Cue v0.4.1 uses dedicated PNG composer icons and listing logos in light and dark modes. Cue scores AI prompts, returns feedback and improved prompts, connects to a Cue account, checks the connected account/plan, and applies Free versus paid Cue usage entitlement.
